scope_outcomes.criterion: A held secondary text must make an attributable, substantive argument about Max Weber, anchored in its own wording.
scope_outcomes.basis: The text explicitly attributes the concept of status groups to Weber and uses it to explain how fractions of the working class manage competition and remain fragmented rather than forming class politics. This supports finding D1.DOC18.F1.
limitations: Only the supplied source text and inspected passages were assessed; this is not a review of the authors’ complete work.
The text’s broader engagement with Weber and the cited Weber source were not independently inspected here.
